description: Use when onboarding a vendor or counterparty and you need one signed composite dossier for examiner-facing diligence. Fans in OFAC, OIG LEIE, and SAM exclusion screening (each with list_version), NPI provider verification, vendor market rate, and contract intelligence — degrading per-section when a sub-source is unavailable rather than failing the whole call. Input entity_name (required). $3.00 USDC per call.
name: get_vendor_onboarding_dossier
